title: dockState v1
description: Dock to Harbor.Shell, on the control channel: where the dock is and what is happening on its monitor, for the island at the top of the same monitor (docs/adr/0013). Sent on every connect and whenever any of it changes: the dock moving to another monitor, a display or work-area change, a full-screen app opening or ending there, the panic hotkey. Coordinates are physical pixels in virtual-screen space, right and bottom exclusive. Any change to this message bumps v.

monitor.description: The bounds of the dock's monitor.

fullScreen.description: A full-screen app is in front on that monitor (docs/adr/0014).

visible.description: The dock is shown: false after the panic hotkey, until hiding the taskbar is turned on again.
